rootCause: The existing browser wait predicate still missed a surface that was visibly rendered after the product performance fix, so it could not distinguish route latency from readiness-predicate failure.
fix: Measure wall-clock route latency directly with 100ms polling.
Cliente360 is usable when route is cliente360, at least one table row exists, no loading and no denial.
Cobros is usable when route is cobros, canonical data-cobros-core-ready exists, no hydration loading and no denial.
Keep <=6000ms as the acceptance threshold and 15000ms only as the observation ceiling.
